headline: Discussed repairs and projects at Jenks, Little, Baldwin, and Fallon; approved prior minutes.
summary: Members discussed summer capital projects at Jenks, Little, Fallon, and Varieur. They also discussed Baldwin Elementary, including HVAC repairs, courtyard drainage, and window film. Members approved the minutes of the previous meeting.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 31, 2026 meeting, with all members voting yes.

decision_evidence.quote: A. August 31, 2026 Motion to approve: Joanne Bonollo Second: Hersh Cristino Yea: all Motion carries.
